source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: hole numbers worked out from the card's lengths and the tees and greens on the map; no hole numbers are marked for this course
unsure.3: tee could be the boxes north-east of the 2nd green instead; picked the ones that fit the card's 145 yards
unsure.9: 9 and 18 look like they share one large green at the north end of the lake; each line ends on its half
unsure.11: no clear tee seen; tee put on the grass north of the green beside the 10th green, to fit the card length
unsure.18: tee taken as the last box on the lake bank south of the lake; the boxes further north on that bank might be the 11th's tees
